description: Get an institutional 13F filer's portfolio style quarter by quarter, measured from its filed common-share book: style band (index-like, systematic-like, concentrated, diversified active), turnover band, holding-horizon band, and the measurements behind them (equity value, stock count, active share against every 13F filer's combined book and against the closest benchmark among the S&P 500, S&P MidCap 400, S&P SmallCap 600, Russell 1000, Russell 2000, Nasdaq-100 and Dow Jones Industrial Average with its as-of date, sector active share, top 10 weight, effective positions, trailing annual turnover, value-weighted holding period), plus the newest quarter's active share against every benchmark. Bands are measurements with stated thresholds, never the firm's own description. Closed quarters only; the newest quarter is measured once its filing window closes.

institutionName.description: Institution name or CIK (a unique partial resolves; ambiguous partials return candidate CIKs)

maxPeriods.description: Number of measured quarters to return, newest first (default: 8, clamped to 1-40)

name: GetInstitutionStyleHistory
title: Institution Style History
